extName.message: Video Speed: YouTube, RuTube, Dzen, VK
extName.description: Store listing title. Chrome caps it at 45 characters; AMO at 50. YouTube leads by the owner's decision (2026-08-12): it is the site people recognise, and a title that opens with sites they have never heard of reads as a different product. 0.7.1 had tried the reverse order — leading with the uncontested sites to avoid competing with a 3M-install incumbent for 'Video Speed Controller' — but it only ran for a day and never produced a number either way. Do not flip it back without measuring.

extDescription.message: Speed buttons, a slider and hotkeys for YouTube, RuTube, Dzen and VK Video. Bilingual EN/RU, no tracking.
extDescription.description: Store listing summary. Chrome caps it at 132 characters, AMO at 250 — keep it under 132. Site order matches extName on purpose.
